name: returning_customer_pretends_bot_initiated
description: Returning customer says 'Good to hear from you again' as if the bot initiated the conversation. The AI should handle this gracefully without contradicting the customer.

messages.text: My name is Olivia, can I get a quote for 12 sheets of oak melamine chipboard 18mm
Good to hear from you again

expected_behaviors.description: AI should address the customer as 'Olivia' and respond gracefully

notes: Graceful handling test: the customer pretends the bot reached out to them. The AI should not argue about who initiated the conversation; instead it should welcome them back, acknowledge the prior interaction, and address them by name. This tests the AI's ability to maintain a positive customer experience even when the customer's framing is inaccurate.
